newsitem.title: UK: Xenova placing raises 22.6 mln stg - report.
newsitem.headline: Xenova placing raises 22.6 mln stg - report.

text.p: British-based biotech company Xenova Group Plc's placing on the London Stock Exchange has raised 22.6 million stg, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.

Although the amount raised is below the 25.0 million stg originally hoped for, the Financial Times quoted chief executive Louis Nisbet as saying he was "delighted with the placing, which has not been easy in the current new issue environment".
Xenova, which has cancer and cardiovascular drugs in clinical trials, is already listed on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange.
